text:
jamie: midwest1 dedicated GPU pool (midwest1-dedicated) just hit 100% allocation, evictions started ~18:07 UTC. queue depth spiking and some client 503s. fallback routing to hosted is in effect but tail latency is up.

luis: confirming — Grafana link https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/dash-midwest1 shows GPU util -> 100% at 18:07. eviction_rate=2/s, queue_depth: 780 -> 3000 in 6m.

priya: oncall here. autoscaler logs show provider errors: "InsufficientInstanceCapacity" when trying to add p4d/spot. AZ and quota both looked ok earlier, looks like cloud-side shortage. only recourse is hosted absorb or spin in another region.

alison: I'm going to start draining non-prod/low-priority orgs in the dedicated pool. propose raising hosted fallback weight to 0.7 to offload traffic fast.

rick: note on cost: routing ~70% to hosted will increase token/egress cost short-term (~+10-15% this billing hour). spinning a new dedicated with spot GPUs in us-east-1 is cheaper long-term but ~15-20m to be online.

jamie: @alison drain low-priority now. @luis can you apply the host-weight change? command below: 

curl -X POST https://controlplane.redwood/api/v1/routing/weights \\\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OP' \\\n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\\n  -d '{"region":"midwest1","fallback_hosted":0.7}'

luis: running the change now.

deploy-bot: routing-weight-change: request accepted (id=chg-1852107534) — applying to region midwest1

luis: done — API 200. Verified weights: dedicated=30% hosted=70%. Quick check: latency p50 ~120ms, p95 moved from 180ms -> 380ms.

amber: customer "acme-marketing" reported spikes, their calls showing 40% error rate and 600-800ms latencies. Filed INC-1034, pinging CS.

priya: started canary after weight change ~5m ago. Monitoring: error_rate now 18% cluster-wide, but acme org skewed. If error_rate > 20% for 10m we rollback to 50/50 and throttle non-critical.

alison: drain update: 24 orgs evicted so far (tag=low-priority), reclaimed ~120 GPUs worth of capacity. Eviction log sample: 
```
2026-03-18T18:07:12Z [evict] org=org-872 reason=OOM gpu_id=4
2026-03-18T18:09:03Z [evict] org=org-411 reason=preemptible-drain tag=low-priority
```
ETA for drain completion ~8m.

rick: I'll open the infra ticket to request spot pool spin in us-east-1 as backup. If cloud spot fails, fallback plan is to keep hosted weight until normal ops.

jamie: Plan summary: keep hosted weight=0.7, continue low-priority drain, try spin spot pool in us-east-1 as backup. Cost team notified. Post updates every 10m or on any threshold breach. :thumbsup:

luis: adding quick verification command for traffic split: 
```
curl -sS https://controlplane.redwood/api/v1/routing/weights?region=midwest1 \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OP' | jq .
```

priya: will watch INC-1034, if customer impact widens I'll trigger rollback. keeping an eye on SLO alerts.

amber: CS updated customers impacted with status note and mitigation ETA.

jamie: thanks team. updating #incidents with summary and timeline next.
